title: "Call for Applications"

**Applications close 30 August 2026.**

## Overview

::: {.intro}
The Geospatial Modelling Workshop is now accepting applications. Spaces
are limited and selection is competitive, so review the eligibility
criteria and practical notes below before applying.
:::

## Eligibility Criteria

- Basic experience with R
- An understanding of statistical inference
- Introductory knowledge of Bayesian statistical methods
- Language of instruction: English
- Applications from female candidates are highly encouraged

## Practical Notes

- Food and drinks are provided. Participants are responsible for
  their own travel and accommodation costs.
- Limited spaces are available, and selection is competitive.

## Ready to Apply?

Review the details above, then submit your application on our
dedicated application platform.
